correctness.rationale: Helper implements the full documented exit/result contract (CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, API_ERROR) with env defaults, allowlist loading, pre/post SHA checks, terminal-state gating, and unresolved-thread counting. Fixture tests exercise INPUT-01–03 and POLL-01–04 paths. Minor gap: reviews are not filtered to the current head commit_id, so stale reviews from prior heads could influence convergence semantics despite the “terminal for the current head” requirement.

Phase 5 prompt docs include result table, env overrides, fallback sleep, and SHA_CHANGED safety rule; AI_REPO_GUIDE and check wiring are synced. Minor deduction for inline GraphQL verbosity and monolithic bats _legacy_body wrapper rather than granular cases.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to seven task-relevant files with no PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, or state-surface churn. Required doc companions (pr-resolve-all.md, AI_REPO_GUIDE.md) updated; time-based fallback preserved; check scripts 105 and 160 wire verification into test.sh.

reliability.rationale: Substantive fixture-mode bats cover syntax, input validation, and four polling outcomes; scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh invokes run_bats_check. Coverage gaps remain for post-snapshot SHA_CHANGED, unresolved-thread blocking, and non-terminal bot states.
